Vote Byrian! For next city council member for District 6 he will get the job done.

I met Dr. Byrian Ramsey in 2024 and learned very quickly he was the type of person (friend, advisor, critical thinker, problem solver, businessman) that I definitely would always want on my side. In what seems like such a short time, I learned a great deal from him. He has the ability to figure things out to have a more favorable outcome in all situations business, and personal. I have seen this in person when he has spoken about being the President of the Lake Forest POA. A position he already takes very seriously and uses to better the Lake Forest Community.  I believe the people of Lake Forest’s District 6 would do themselves and the Daphne community a great service by voting for him. Today I do call him my friend, but I will always consider him a mentor. He has my utmost respect and support. Vote For Byrian Ramsey!!!

Dr. Ramsey is actually involved with our community. He creates and organizes activities & programs for the residents that he participates in. My wife and neighbors love the bingo sessions, and the dinner deals at the 19th Hole. The holiday cook offs are alot of fun. 

Dr. Ramsey puts his community first by taking a firm stance against short-term rentals in Lake Forest while Benjamin Hughes has publicly posted on social media that he is for them. The current Lake Forest board is in the process of:
Cleaning up the marina, repairing the proshop building, and actually enforcing the covenants  in Lake Forest. This is thanks to Dr. Ramsey's leadership. My family will be voting for Dr. Ramsey. 

John
Dr Ramsey is a great guy and perfect for the job. He will get things done, no excuses! He will work hard and keep his word - guaranteed.

I have known Byrian for almost 20 years dating back to when he was one of my professors at the college I was attending. Since day one, he was very attentive to the needs of the students, always put us first, and went above and beyond for each and every student, in and out of the classroom. He was the only teacher I have ever had to do that, and that truly stuck with me. Although we come from totally different walks of life, when I got a chance to speak to him outside of the classroom, it was like I’ve known him my entire life. Dr. Ramsey is a man that is extremely down to earth, although having accomplished so much professionally. He was always willing to go above and beyond for those in need, and is just a remarkable human being altogether. If elected, the great people of Daphne won’t have anything to worry about because they’ll be in good hands. He’ll fight for you, and do everything in his power to improve things, and make it better, meanwhile doing it through integrity, and outstanding leadership.

I have lived in Daphne for 9 years and when we first moved to Lake Forrest we couldn’t wait to get out . Ever since I bought another home 2 years ago I have been very pleased with all that Byrian has done . I have seen a big difference and I enjoy the things Lake Forrest has to offer now and how much cleaner it is .  I try to keep comments off things like this but after I have seen no much hate and how bad people are treating him that is running against him it breaks my heart . Some ppl would have already ran and said forget it , but no matter what is said or how bad people say he is ….. He still shows up , he is still standing here and always has a smile on his face . I can’t even do that sometimes bc this world is horrible to everyone . I wish u the best and I believe he will do everything in his power to make our community and city Better !! U got my vote plus the 5 others in my house that is old enough to vote ! Keep being you and just keep being positive let the others keep being the negative .
Dr Ramsey is a very dedicated professional and cares about the community. He will do a great job!
